title: VoxelGI and SDFGI inject π too much direct light because the Lambert 1 / PI factor is missing
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f] - The same code path is still present in master [00932449c] ### System information macOS 26.5.1 - Vulkan (Forward+) ### Issue description #### What doesn't work When **Physical Light Units** (`rendering/lights_and_shadows/use_physical_light_units`) are enabled, indirect bounce light in **VoxelGI** and **SDFGI** is **$\pi$ times too bright (+1.65 EV / ~3.14x)** relative to direct lighting on the same surface. This results in an overexposed, washed-out first bounce. #### Expected behavior The indirect bounce brightness should match the directly lit surface regardless of whether physical light units are enabled or disabled (matching the behavior in direct lighting and LightmapGI). #### Why this happens The Lambertian diffuse BRDF normalization factor `1.0 / PI` is missing from the physical-units light injection path in `gi.cpp`: 1. **Direct Lighting**: The shader divides diffuse BRDF by `PI` ([`scene_forward_lights_inc.glsl`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/scene_forward_lights_inc.glsl#L240-L244)). - **Default (non-physical)**: The CPU pre-multiplies light energy by `Math::PI` ([`light_storage.cpp`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/light_storage.cpp#L756-L762)), cancelling out the shader's `1 / PI`. - **Physical units**: The CPU passes raw photometric intensity directly, letting the shader's `1 / PI` divide it correctly. 2. **LightmapGI**: Had this exact same bug and was fixed in PR [#122131](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122131) (`aecdb33556`) by adding `energy *= 1.0 / Math::PI` under physical units. 3. **VoxelGI & SDFGI (`gi.cpp`)**: Injection shaders store `albedo * irradiance * NdotL` without dividing by `PI`. Under default units, this accidentally matches direct lighting (`1.0 == 1.0`). But under physical units, the CPU packs raw intensity without applying `1.0 / Math::PI`, injecting $\pi$ times too much radiance into the GI grids. | Lighting Path | Non-Physical Units | Physical Light Units | Status | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Direct Lighting** (`light_storage.cpp` + shader) | CPU `* PI`, Shader `* 1/PI` $\rightarrow$ Net `1.0` | CPU intensity, Shader `* 1/PI` $\rightarrow$ Net `* 1/PI` | Correct | | **LightmapGI** (`lightmap_gi.cpp`) | No factor $\rightarrow$ Net `1.0` | Intensity `* 1/PI` (fixed in [#122131](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122131)) | Correct | | **VoxelGI / SDFGI** (`gi.cpp`) | No factor $\rightarrow$ Net `1.0` | Raw Intensity (**Missing `* 1/PI`**) | **$\pi$ too bright** | --- ### Scope - **Affects**: `DirectionalLight3D`, `OmniLight3D`, and `SpotLight3D` across both **VoxelGI** and **SDFGI** (both static cells and dynamic objects). - **Not affected**: Non-physical light units (behavior remains completely unchanged). - **Note on AreaLight3D**: Uses LTC and has a separate discrepancy ($2\pi$ ratio), tracked in #122457. - **Related**: HDDAGI PR #119869 shares the SDFGI injection path and will need the same factor. --- ### Suggested fix In [`servers/rendering/renderer_rd/environment/gi.cpp`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/environment/gi.cpp), add the `1.0 / Math::PI` normalization to the physical-units branch across all 4 light-packing sites: - `SDFGI::pre_process_gi()` (Directional: L1941, Positional: L2000) - `SDFGI::render_static_lights()` (L2491) - `VoxelGIInstance::update_light()` (L2991) ```cpp if (RendererSceneRenderRD::get_singleton()->is_using_physical_light_units()) { lights[idx].energy *= RSG::light_storage->light_get_param(light, RSE::LIGHT_PARAM_INTENSITY); // Lambert diffuse normalization, matching direct lighting and LightmapGI (#122131). lights[idx].energy *= 1.0 / Math::PI; ... } ``` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open and run the attached MRP with default settings (`use_physical_light_units` = `false`). - Use `[1]` / `[2]` / `[3]` to switch lights (Directional / Omni / Spot). - Use `[W]` (SDFGI) / `[E]` (VoxelGI) to switch GI modes. Note the measured indirect bounce values on the HUD. 2. In **Project Settings**, enable `rendering/lights_and_shadows/use_physical_light_units` and run the MRP again. 3. **Observed**: The directly lit region (Cyan box) remains numerically identical, while the indirect bounce light (Orange box) becomes **$\pi$ times (~3.14x / +1.65 EV) brighter** across all light and GI types. 4. **Expected**: Indirect bounce radiance should maintain consistent intensity relative to direct lighting regardless of the physical units setting. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [GI-Lambert-1-PI-MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31255208/GI-Lambert-1-PI-MRP.zip)
